pareto_rule: Pareto-optimal when no other operating point has both a lower-or-equal val mean W1 and a lower-or-equal steady-state seconds per 1k with at least one strict win. The Pareto set is the result; the fastest point is never claimed best on speed alone.

discriminator_protocol.note: identical protocol for every method and seed

comparison.ci_scope_note: Intervals resample blocks within each of the 4 test sessions and pool them; they are across-session evidence about the recorded sessions, not about unrecorded days.

limitations: single training seed (0); one DDPM and one VAE trained
validation/test subsamples of 1000 windows, not the full splits
test metrics are confirmation only; Pareto selection uses val W1
cold-start probe pays process warmup only for the first method
CPU-only run; GPU latency is not measured here
VAE comparator trained at lr 2e-4, not the shipped 1e-3: the shipped rate diverges to nan in 2 of 3 tried initializations on the expanded corpus; see VAE_LR note
